Samir Patel: New hire started Aug 2, blackout Aug 10-14. They need Aug 11 off for a dentist appt and only have 4h PTO left. Can we prorate or grant an exception?

Lina Gomez: We prorate accruals for mid-cycle starts. For medical exceptions People Ops approval + manager sign-off required.

Priya Das: Im the hiring manager, I can approve if HR confirms. Is a medical note required?

hr-bot: Policy: https://redwood.internal/hr/pto-policy (Exceptions). Medical note needed to convert to sick; carryover needs People Ops logged exception.

Samir Patel: Action plan: manager to add BambooHR comment tagging people-ops, employee to send note to hr@redwood.com, People Ops to log exception before payroll cutoff (Aug 20).

Lina Gomez: I will log the exception and notify payroll to watch for tag #PTO-EXCEPTION. If note not received by Aug22, exception revoked.

Priya Das: Added BambooHR comment: "Approve 1 day carryover Aug11 for medical; employee will submit note by Aug20."

Samir Patel: Thanks all, please confirm once payroll acknowledged.

Lina Gomez: Confirmed, payroll notified and exception recorded: INC-ptocarry-19750.
